$comment: Project-owned ai-harness configuration. Every key is documented in docs/CONFIG.md of ai-harness. This file is yours: the harness never rewrites it.

protect.$comment: Paths the harness hook guards for this project. Add your own; an empty list protects nothing.

gates.$comment: One entry per area: the paths that mark the area as changed, and the steps to run. Example below; replace with your own.

routines.$comment: Run discipline (docs/CONFIG.md). These are the defaults: one item per run, no run ledger. Turn on the ledger, raise the budget and add parallel subagents together, and space the routines' schedules so that no two runs overlap.
